fieldNotes.location: Resolved with high confidence. Roster geocode (movedMeters 5664) lands directly on the long cross-dock RDC building at 2300 Beckleymeade Ave in the Dallas Logistics Hub (south Dallas, zip 75232). Confirmed as HD RDC #5023 / XD06 via SupplierWiki and FCC license records (DC 5023).
fieldNotes.truckGate: CONFIRMED via Street View on Beckleymeade Ave: a swing/sliding gate spans the truck entrance driveway, set well back from the public road with a deep paved apron; full perimeter security fencing (black ornamental + chain-link) wraps the property.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small structure is visible just inside the gate in both satellite and Street View — staffed guard-booth check-in, consistent with the HD RDC standard.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock RDC layout — dock doors run along both long faces of the building; inbound (receiving) and outbound (shipping) operate from physically separate dock banks.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dense trailer parking in long rows on the building's west/south side, hundreds of trailers without tractors — dropArea 50+, dedicated drop yard.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~130 estimate across both long elevations of a ~550K sq ft RDC; exact count obscured by backed-in trailers — listed uncertain.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron and deep approach leave room for an express bypass lane.
